messages:
jess_sales: Heads-up: just closed a deal with Meridian Labs (Enterprise). Customer asks for private deployment in eu-central, Okta SSO, and a 2-week proof-of-concept on dedicated nodes. Passing to CS + ENG to scope. Please pick activation owner today.

liam_cs: I can lead activation. Need quick confirmation on network topology (peering vs transit gateway) and whether they need outbound fixed IPs.

jess_sales: They'll use a transit gateway and want 2 fixed egress IPs for allowlisting. Sending the signed SOW and network sketch to INF-5010.

tanvi_cs_manager: Assigning @liam_cs as CS activation owner. Please create an onboarding runbook and schedule a combined kickoff call (CS + ENG + Support) within 5 business days. Flagging renewal risk: medium-high if POC >45 days.

liam_cs: Noted. Draft acceptance criteria idea: 1) successful peering with TLS tunnels; 2) SSO login for 3 admins; 3) test prompt latency p50 <250ms; 4) sample indexing job completes within target SLA. Feedback capture: short post-POC survey + feature-requests doc.

airo_eng: @liam_cs I'll own infra scoping. Quick questions: expected concurrent sessions and model sizes? Also, do they need GPU isolation (dedicated tenant)?

jess_sales: Concurrent sessions ~30, avg token length 600, occasional batch indexing jobs hitting 3k tokens. They want tenant isolation for compliance.

airo_eng: Good. Preliminary plan: 3x80GB GPUs (or equivalent) for POC with dedicated tenancy. I'll open INF-5010 and add capacity plan + network checklist. Smoke test we use: 
```
./smoke_test.sh --env=meridian-poc --check-network --run-latency --token=REDACTED
```
Will add run commands to ticket.

frank_support: I'll prepare the on-call rota and a triage runbook. Please include expected error patterns (auth failures, high-latency bursts) so I can add relevant alerts.

liam_cs: Good call. I'll add a short list of observed failure cases from previous POCs and share sample logs. Also scheduling a 45-minute kickoff: 15m customer intro, 30m technical deep-dive.

tanvi_cs_manager: Add product success metrics to the runbook: time-to-first-successful-inference, POC NPS, and any blocked feature asks. If invoice processing slips, escalate — procurement has a 30-day SLA with them.

deploy_bot: INF-5010 created by airo_eng. Monitoring playbook assigned to frank_support.

liam_cs: Action list (owners + due dates):
- liam_cs: onboarding runbook + kickoff invites (Due: 2024-01-14)
- airo_eng: INF-5010 capacity + network checklist (Due: 2024-01-10)
- frank_support: runbook + on-call setup (Due: 2024-01-12)
- jess_sales: upload SOW + network diagram to INF-5010 (Due: 2024-01-08)

tanvi_cs_manager: I'll follow up mid-week and will escalate to infra lead if we hit blockers. Keep the ticket updated; set priority to P1 for POC provisioning.

jess_sales: Thanks all. I'll ping the customer about allowlist IPs today and confirm go/no-go dates. :rocket:
